llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam indicators: (1) an unusually large variety of expensive branded goods at very large discounts, (2) use of limited-time and urgency-based psychological tactics, (3) ambiguous company information with a generic-sounding company name, questionable email address, and rough address formatting, (4) use of a non-standard domain ('.cyou') that is rare for legitimate Japanese e-commerce, and (5) the WHOIS lookup returns no ownership/registrant details and instead flags potential abuse. These all match patterns typical of fake online shopping scams.
